Subject: POC kickoff - recap, action items, and next steps

Hi team - thanks for a productive kickoff yesterday. Quick recap and owners: 

Highlights:
- Walked through 15 sample prompts (Acme) and iterated on a routing policy for customer-facing queries.
- Live demo showed median latency of ~120ms on our dedicated test harness at 5 QPS.
- Load test run (Dev) validated baseline throughput; Dev captured traces for two slow tail cases.

Action items (owner - ETA):
- Jordan: Share expanded prompt set (50 prompts) and clarify expected peak QPS (target: 2026-03-26)
- Dev Patel: Post session, upload load-test traces and recommended kernel/quantization profile (target: 2026-03-25)
- Ethan Park: Draft mutual action plan and pricing posture for Dedicated (target: 2026-03-27)
- Laura Bennett: Coordinate procurement touchpoint and share initial contract checklist with contracts@acme.com (target: 2026-03-26)

Next session proposal:
- Deep-dive on routing + long-tail mitigation and expanded load tests (90 minutes)
- Proposed slot: Tue 2026-03-30 09:00-10:30 PT

Please reply with availability for the proposed next session. I've attached the final POC agenda and the load-test plan and added session notes to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Acme-POC-Notes

Thanks again - great collaboration.

--
Marissa Cole
